subject: project-nereid
q: CLOSED — GO BY THE DOCUMENT. THOSE ARE THE PHRASES.
detail:
ANSWERED IN SIX WORDS: GO BY THE DOC, THOSE ARE THE PHRASES.

THE ABS UNLOCK IS GIVE HER THE GRATER. THE PUBIC HAIR UNLOCK IS GONNA NEED THE CARPET TO MATCH THE DRAPES. Singular carpet.

AND THE RULING DECIDES WHO IS SPEAKING, which was the part that actually mattered. HER, NOT ME — so the phrase belongs to A WIFE AT THE DESK ASKING FOR HER WOMAN. GIVE ME THE GRATER would have been a woman asking for herself, and Torie’s in-scene claim would have made her the asker. NEITHER IS THE PHRASE. The Archive’s two misheard wordings are kept here as the record of what it got wrong, and the document’s wording is the only one that opens anything.

WHY IT WAS WORTH ASKING RATHER THAN PICKING: a Secret Menu gate is KNOWLEDGE OF THE EXACT WORDS. Normalising a phrase would have been editing the lock, and the Archive has been caught tidying text it did not understand before — see q-worl-truck. One question, one sentence back, both phrases exact.

THE STANDING RULE IS UNTOUCHED BY THE ANSWER: a Secret Menu phrase is recorded so the system can RECOGNISE it, AND IS NEVER SURFACED TO A WOMAN WHO HAS NOT SAID ONE FIRST.
